## What's new
Two new colourful **pastel themes**:

- **Pastel Lavender** – a lavender background with a violet accent (`#7445e0`)
- **Pastel Peach** – a warm peach background with a raspberry-pink accent (`#d0386c`)

Both bring more colour than a plain light theme:
- every service card is **tinted in its service's pastel colour** – butter yellow (Radarr), sky blue (Sonarr), periwinkle (qBittorrent), mint (NZBGet) and lilac (Seerr) – on the Overview, Downloads, History and Requests tabs
- pastel service colours for progress bars, dots and card edges, a tinted header and active menu tab
- applied on first page load; all other themes look exactly as before
- contrast-checked: body text ≥ 11:1, secondary text ≥ 5:1 even on the most tinted card

Choose them in **⚙ Settings → Appearance → Theme**.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.6.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                          # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0
